04 / THE STORY

A playful name.
A practical conviction.

The name is a nod to “6–7”: hard to explain, easy to feel. Behind it is a practical idea: turn everyday spreadsheets into useful business apps that stay in the customer’s hands.

6↔7
A LITTLE UNEXPECTED. BUILT TO BE USEFUL.
01

Built close to the work.

Built by Gaston Fourcade, who wrote his father’s business systems in dBASE and Lotus 1-2-3, then led technology at Globant and Auna.

dBASELotus 1-2-3
02

Ideas travel further together.

Ideas get stronger when people with different experience build together. Cross-company collaboration connects shared learning with the practical needs of everyday work.

03

Make more of what you have.

The build reflects the product’s approach: start with what is already available, keep things practical, and create room for what comes next.
